name: switchyard
description: One local yard for every AI coding session: search the archive, watch agents live, track schedules, and hand a chat to another account or tool when the limit hits.
author: Huseyin Kaplan

scripts.build: npm run build -w @switchyard/ui && npm run build -w @switchyard/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @switchyard/ui && npm run typecheck -w @switchyard/cli && npm run typecheck -w @switchyard/playground
